title: VibeVoice: Free Open-Source Voice AI for Long Speech & Transcription
description:
VibeVoice is a family of open-source voice AI models from Microsoft. It can synthesize up to 90 minutes of multi-speaker speech or transcribe an hour of audio with speaker diarization. Try it for free on Hugging Face or Colab.
